summary: Eleven defects, all cited to a verified commit hash or file:line. The dominant failure mode is APPEND-ONLY LEDGERING: every correction in this repo is written as a NEW entry and the refuted entry is left standing, in the same commit. Commit 335e615 and b1a49b6 added 141 and 77 lines to docs/DIVERGENCES.md with ZERO deletions while reversing four of its head entries; commit 2f8d88d declared itself a 'LEDGER CORRECTION ONLY' and never touched docs/DIVERGENCES.md at all. The result is that RESUME_HERE.md contradicts itself 500 lines apart (lines 73-88 vs 577-583) about whether stance is hard-locked, DIVERGENCES.md line 44 still carries three separately-refuted clauses in one four-line entry, and src/core/Sim.ts line 588 names a constant deleted from the repo by the same commit that rewrote the code 17 lines below it. Enforcement census (deliverable (c)): 36 standing rules identified across CLAUDE.md, .claude/ship-bar.md and the three folder CLAUDE.md files - 11 ENFORCED by a named test or hook, 2 PARTIAL, 23 PROSE-ONLY. The two rules with the worst incident record (RESUME_HERE same-commit, SESSION-LOG per-milestone) are both PROSE-ONLY, and .githooks/pre-commit's markdown fast-path means every commit that touches only ledgers is verified by nothing at all - that is the mechanism the rot travels through. src/core/CLAUDE.md and src/game/CLAUDE.md have not been edited since the Stage 0 scaffold commit 15a7f08 (2026-07-11), across 214 subsequent commits.

findings.claim: RESUME_HERE.md's 'Stage landmines from research' block carries FIVE claims that later commits in this same repo explicitly refuted, and the file contradicts itself about one of them 500 lines apart - line 83 points at the stale block, says it is wrong, and leaves it in place.
findings.cite: RESUME_HERE.md:577-583 (block introduced ebc1335, 2026-07-11, never amended in 214 commits); self-contradicted by RESUME_HERE.md:73-88 (commit 2f8d88d, 2026-08-22)
findings.evidence: RESUME_HERE.md:578-583 at HEAD: 'Stance is HARD-LOCKED in combat in v0.717 PvE (SYNTHESIS 6.1) - implement out-of-combat switch as CONTRACT + Focus-gated in-combat variant as INFERRED. ... `critical.ts`: two meters (Focus = stance switch, Critical = crits). PvE trash resolves 3-10 s - DUEL_TARGET_SECONDS {20,60} is a boss/PvP number. Combo counter resets to 1 (not 0) per kill; breaks on damage taken/chain gap.' Refutations, each verified: (1) RESUME_HERE.md:83 in the SAME FILE - 'A hard lock needs no cycler, no threshold and no debit. **The Stage-2 landmine below marks the in-combat stance switch INFERRED; it is CONTRACT, at threshold 48.**' (2) `ls src/core/critical.ts` -> 'No such file or directory'; `grep -rn CRITICAL_MAX src/` -> zero hits; deleted in 335e615 per docs/DIVERGENCES.md:781-783. (3) src/config/ai.ts:105 `export const DUEL_TARGET_SECONDS = { min: 8, max: 25 };` - changed in 335e615. (4) docs/DIVERGENCES.md:692-696 (commit b1a49b6) 'Combo resets to 1 on a kill was WRONG. It resets to 0, and only when the player takes damage - never on a kill. COMBO_CHAIN_GAP_S modelled a decay that does not exist. Deleted.' (5) RESUME_HERE.md:569-570 'RECREATE-NEVER-RIP (drawings/dialogue always original; palette now near-OG per owner veto 2026-07-12)' - superseded by CLAUDE.md:18-19 'owner ruling 2026-07-24 ... supersedes ... the 2026-07-12 palette policy'. `git log -1 -L 576,584:RESUME_HERE.md` -> ebc1335 2026-07-11. Blast radius: CLAUDE.md:6-7 names RESUME_HERE.md as where 'current state and next step live', and scripts/build-loop.sh:70 feeds it verbatim to autonomous agents as their prompt.
findings.rule_targeted: CLAUDE.md:48 - 'RESUME_HERE.md (repo root) - refreshed in the SAME commit as the change it describes.'
findings.proposed_change: Delete RESUME_HERE.md:577-583 outright (it is a 2026-07-11 research block, superseded four times over) and delete the parenthetical at :570. Then amend CLAUDE.md:48 to the rule that actually failed: 'RESUME_HERE.md - refreshed in the SAME commit as the change it describes, and a claim a commit REFUTES is deleted in that commit, not annotated elsewhere in the file.'

findings.claim: docs/DIVERGENCES.md's in-combat-stance entry is false in all three of its clauses, and the commit that overturned it declared itself a 'LEDGER CORRECTION ONLY' while never touching docs/DIVERGENCES.md - the file whose stated job is exactly that.
findings.evidence: docs/DIVERGENCES.md:44-47 at HEAD: '- **In-combat stance switch = Focus-gated (v0.717 PvE hard-locks stance)** - SYNTHESIS 6.1. Out-of-combat free switch is CONTRACT; the Focus-gated in-combat variant is our INFERRED playability reading. Cost = FOCUS_SWITCH_COST x WEAPON_WEIGHT[stance being LEFT] (veto = key on target stance).' Clause 1 refuted by 2f8d88d's own body: 'THE HEADLINE - "STANCE IS HARD-LOCKED IN COMBAT" IS A MISREAD OF A FRAME ... A hard lock needs no cycler, no threshold and no debit.' Clause 2 refuted by the same commit: 'The in-combat switch is CONTRACT, at threshold 48 - the recreation's "INFERRED" Focus-gated variant IS the original', and by src/config/combat.ts:104-108 which already reads 'CONTRACT-SRC - in-combat stance switching costs 48 Focus and is GATED on affording it'. Clause 3 refuted by 335e615: `git show 335e615 -- src/config/combat.ts` shows '-export const WEAPON_WEIGHT = { light: 1.0, balanced: 1.5, heavy: 2.5 } as const;' and '+ * `WEAPON_WEIGHT` table that has no source basis; both are deleted (D9)'. `grep -rn WEAPON_WEIGHT src/` returns only tombstone comments - the identifier does not exist. `git show --pretty= --name-only 2f8d88d` lists 20 files, ALL under docs/gauntlet/L0/ - docs/DIVERGENCES.md is not among them. `git log --oneline 2f8d88d..HEAD -- docs/DIVERGENCES.md` returns EMPTY: no commit since the overturn has touched the ledger.
findings.rule_targeted: docs/DIVERGENCES.md:5-8 - 'CONTRACT values are never silently changed - if evidence ever contradicts one, the contract wins and the contradiction is logged here.'
findings.proposed_change: Replace docs/DIVERGENCES.md:44-47 with: '- **In-combat stance switch = CONTRACT-SRC, flat 48 Focus** (2f8d88d, 2026-08-22): the decompiled source shows a threshold, a four-branch cycler and a debit - not a hard lock. Supersedes the SYNTHESIS 6.1 "hard-locked / INFERRED" reading and the deleted WEAPON_WEIGHT scaling (335e615).' Add to the file's Rules paragraph: 'A commit that refutes an entry EDITS that entry; appending a correction elsewhere is not a correction.'

findings.claim: docs/DIVERGENCES.md's normalized head section is append-only-rotted: three more entries beyond L-02 were reversed by SESSION 13 and left standing, because both reversal commits appended to the file with ZERO deletions.
findings.evidence: Line 60-61 at HEAD: '- **COMBO_CHAIN_GAP_S = 3 s** INFERRED; combo resets to 1 (not 0) per kill - CONTRACT.' vs line 692-696 of the SAME FILE: 'Combo resets to 1 on a kill was WRONG. It resets to 0 ... COMBO_CHAIN_GAP_S modelled a decay that does not exist. Deleted.' Line 53-54: '- **AI reactMs = attention cooldown, one decision roll per window** - flagged reading' vs src/config/ai.ts:10-12 'reactMs / reactBlockChance / reactDodgeChance - the enemy does not ... react() modelled behaviour the game lacks' and tests/AISeamController.test.ts:198 `expect(tier).not.toHaveProperty('reactMs')`. Line 117-119: '- **DUEL_TARGET_SECONDS {20,60} treated as boss/PvP band**' vs src/config/ai.ts:105 `export const DUEL_TARGET_SECONDS = { min: 8, max: 25 };`. Mechanism, measured: `git show 335e615 -- docs/DIVERGENCES.md | grep -c '^+[^+]'` = 141 added lines; `| grep -c '^-[^-]'` = 0 deleted. `git show b1a49b6 -- docs/DIVERGENCES.md` = 77 added, 0 deleted. Both commits touched the ledger and neither removed one character of what they refuted.
findings.rule_targeted: docs/DIVERGENCES.md:3-8 - 'one ledger instead of flags scattered across RESUME_HERE, session log, and config comments'
findings.proposed_change: Strike lines 53-54, 60-61 and 117-119 in place, each replaced with a one-line superseded-by pointer naming the commit (335e615 / b1a49b6). Then add a CI or pre-commit assertion: a commit whose diff deletes an exported symbol from src/config/ must also produce a deletion (not only an addition) in docs/DIVERGENCES.md.

findings.claim: docs/DIVERGENCES.md's own governing rule - 'the contract wins' - is dead, and the file documents its own death without amending the rule.
findings.evidence: The rule, docs/DIVERGENCES.md:5-8: '**Rules:** CONTRACT values are never silently changed - if evidence ever contradicts one, the contract wins and the contradiction is logged here.' The incident, docs/DIVERGENCES.md:691, verbatim heading: '### A2 - combo corrected (D8). **This reverses a Stage-2 CONTRACT.**' The contract did not win; the measurement did, and correctly so. Two further CONTRACT-class reversals in the same lane: docs/DIVERGENCES.md:866 'XP 90, not 10. Our +10/+8 was verified only against OUR OWN build's screenshots - never an OG measurement - so the Stage-2 gate row is corrected rather than left silently false'; and 2f8d88d flipping the stance switch from INFERRED to CONTRACT-SRC (see L-02). The rule as written would have blocked all three of the repo's best corrections.
findings.proposed_change: Replace 'the contract wins and the contradiction is logged here' with 'the MEASUREMENT wins, the entry is struck in place in the same commit, and the reversal is logged here with its commit hash.' That is what the repo already does three times over; the rule is the only thing out of date.

findings.claim: src/config/CLAUDE.md states a palette/art policy that the owner superseded on 2026-07-24 and that is now factually false of the shipped source: the repo draws art traced byte-for-byte out of the original game's payload.
findings.cite: src/config/CLAUDE.md:14-16 (file last touched e8a6d82, 2026-07-12); superseded by CLAUDE.md:18-21 (commit 44ef334, 2026-07-27)
findings.evidence: src/config/CLAUDE.md:14-16: '- `palette.ts` sits at near-OG hues (owner veto of the trade-dress shift, 2026-07-12). **Drawings stay original** - the palette is the only thing that moved toward the original.' Superseded verbatim by CLAUDE.md:18-19: '**LICENSED 1:1 RECREATION (owner ruling 2026-07-24 - supersedes the old "never traced/transcribed" art line and the 2026-07-12 palette policy).**' Falsified by shipped source: src/game/art/generated/ holds 22 files; shape2641.ts header reads 'source characterId : 2641 (DefineShape in the OG payload)' and 'Colours are BYTE-EXACT to the SWF's recorded RGB'. tests/game-purity-ratchet.test.ts:29-31 describes the same directory as 'vector art TRACED FROM THE ORIGINAL GAME ... thousands of coordinates read out of the OG's own DefineShape records.' The identical superseded line also survives at docs/DIVERGENCES.md:36-39 ('drawings and dialogue remain ALWAYS original (the hard line). Never re-shift.'). `git log -1 -- src/config/CLAUDE.md` -> e8a6d82 2026-07-12: the file has not been opened since, across 205 commits.
findings.proposed_change: Replace src/config/CLAUDE.md:14-16 with: '- `palette.ts` sits at exact OG hues. Tracing and hue-matching are PERMITTED under the owner-recorded Lut Games grant (docs/MASTER_SPEC.md, 2026-07-24); traced art lives in src/game/art/generated/ with a provenance header per file.' Strike docs/DIVERGENCES.md:36-39 the same way.

findings.claim: src/core/Sim.ts's stance-switch docblock documents a formula that the SAME COMMIT deleted, naming a constant that no longer exists anywhere in the repo, 17 lines above code whose own comment says the opposite.
findings.evidence: src/core/Sim.ts:588 at HEAD: 'in combat it costs FOCUS_SWITCH_COST x WEAPON_WEIGHT[current stance] (INFERRED - the stance being LEFT proxies how heavily the weapon is committed; veto = key on the target stance instead).' src/core/Sim.ts:603-605, seventeen lines below: '// CONTRACT-SRC (D9/P3): a flat 48 Focus, gated on affording it ... const cost = FOCUS_SWITCH_COST;'. Proof the same commit did it: `git show 335e615^:src/core/Sim.ts | grep -n WEAPON_WEIGHT` -> '7:  WEAPON_WEIGHT,' / '389: ... x WEAPON_WEIGHT[current stance]' / '403: const cost = FOCUS_SWITCH_COST * WEAPON_WEIGHT[f.stance];'. `git show 335e615:src/core/Sim.ts | grep -n WEAPON_WEIGHT` -> '449: ... x WEAPON_WEIGHT[current stance]' ONLY: the import went, the code went, the docblock stayed. `grep -rn WEAPON_WEIGHT src/` at HEAD returns no declaration - the symbol is gone from the repo. Nothing catches this: typecheck cannot see inside a comment, and eslint has no rule for it.
findings.rule_targeted: CLAUDE.md:44 'Commit = green' / .claude/ship-bar.md clause 3 - 'the handoff/README doc updated in the SAME commit as behaviour changes'
findings.proposed_change: Replace src/core/Sim.ts:585-591 with: 'Stance switching (2f8d88d): out of combat instant and free; in combat a flat FOCUS_SWITCH_COST (48), gated on affording it - CONTRACT-SRC, not INFERRED. Denied switches emit an event so the HUD can flash the Focus bar.' Then add a repo-wide grep gate to the suite: any identifier named in a src/ comment that is not declared anywhere in src/ fails.

findings.claim: The 'RESUME_HERE refreshed in the SAME commit' rule is PROSE-ONLY and has a 31.6% failure rate over the repo's whole history.
findings.evidence: Command run: for every commit, list files; if any starts with 'src/' and 'RESUME_HERE.md' is absent, count it. Output: 'src-touching commits: 76' / 'missing RESUME_HERE: 24' = 31.6%. Recent named offenders: 0719673f6c3f11a1723de745cc8ec4c74aa299ef 'SESSION23 A11.4 fix: distance-driven stride', ed25c20aead4451831deca9fe5979ff9777dd81a 'SESSION22 A9.4 by OWNER RULING: the gi lands', 57dd54115157df548549f2b51103a156a11e659c 'SESSION20 A6.4: the loop ran', 10f1d8841bd6e65bd8dbe4aab47d395b29d28f6f 'SESSION20 A6.5 (gi)', 290ebeca9568f66597f8f6ff2e57798ec8e76ed5 'SESSION19 A5.4: the sleeves'. Enforcement surface: `grep -rn 'RESUME_HERE' .githooks/ .github/ tests/` returns hits only in scripts/build-loop.sh (a prompt string) - nothing in the pre-commit hook, nothing in ci.yml, no test. .claude/settings.json's only hook is a UserPromptSubmit that `cat`s .claude/ship-bar.md; it verifies nothing.
findings.rule_targeted: CLAUDE.md:48 - 'RESUME_HERE.md (repo root) - refreshed in the SAME commit as the change it describes.'
findings.proposed_change: Add to .githooks/pre-commit, after the docs-only fast-path: `if printf '%s\n' "$STAGED" | grep -q '^src/' && ! printf '%s\n' "$STAGED" | grep -qx 'RESUME_HERE.md'; then echo '[gate] src/ changed without RESUME_HERE.md - stage it or --no-verify'; exit 1; fi`. Then append four words to CLAUDE.md:48: '(enforced by .githooks/pre-commit)'.

findings.claim: The 'SESSION-LOG updated per milestone, never at the end' rule is PROSE-ONLY and has been dead for 59 commits and 27 days - the entire SESSION 24 / gauntlet L0 lane produced zero entries.
findings.evidence: `git log -1 -- docs/sessions/-SESSION-LOG.md` -> '4601761 2026-07-28 SESSION23 A11.5 wrap'. `git rev-list --count 4601761..HEAD` -> 59. HEAD is '2df2f87 2026-08-24'. The log's final entry reads '**05:00** SESSION 23 CLOSED.' Meanwhile docs/sessions/SESSION24_KICKOFF.md exists (dated 2026-08-13) and the 59 commits include a full multi-wave judging lane: 7a9a7d9 'gauntlet L0 wave A: judged 1,555 -> 1,600', 2f8d88d 'wave B ... judged 1,600 -> 1,621', 34eff6b 'wave C', ab93692 'wave D', 7bc726b 'wave E', 0d8aa6d 'WALL #11'. None of it is in the session log. Enforcement surface: same as L-07 - grep of .githooks/, .github/ and tests/ finds no reference to -SESSION-LOG.md outside scripts/build-loop.sh:74 (a prompt string).
findings.rule_targeted: CLAUDE.md:49 - 'docs/sessions/-SESSION-LOG.md - updated per milestone, never "at the end."'
findings.proposed_change: Judge the rule on its incident record and DELETE it. RESUME_HERE.md plus the commit bodies already carry the per-milestone narrative (2f8d88d's body is 30 lines of it), and a 214KB log that stops 27 days before HEAD is worse than no log. If it is kept instead, it must be enforced the same way L-07 proposes; a third unenforced session-discipline line is not worth its words.

findings.claim: ENFORCEMENT CENSUS (deliverable (c)): of 36 standing rules across CLAUDE.md, .claude/ship-bar.md and the three folder CLAUDE.md files, 11 are ENFORCED, 2 PARTIAL, and 23 are PROSE-ONLY - and .githooks/pre-commit's markdown fast-path means the ledgers themselves are the one artifact class that no gate ever inspects.
findings.evidence: ENFORCED (11), with the enforcing test named: [1] core ZERO numeric literals - tests/config-purity.test.ts:51. [2] core no bare/package imports - tests/config-purity.test.ts:58. [3] core no unscannable payload files - tests/config-purity.test.ts:63. [4] scanner catches type-position/enum-ordinal/template/default-param literals - tests/config-purity.test.ts:88-94 self-test. [5] config imports resolve only inside config - tests/config-purity.test.ts:69. [6] config no unscannable payload files - tests/config-purity.test.ts:73. [7] spec-pinned config values double-entered - tests/config-values.test.ts (137 expect() pins, e.g. :185 CRIT_MULT 1.3). [8] src/game no image/audio/payload files - tests/game-purity-ratchet.test.ts:94 listUnscannableFiles(GAME_DIR). [9] src/game numeric-literal ratchet vs tests/game-purity-baseline.json - tests/game-purity-ratchet.test.ts. [10] tests never load Phaser or src/game - tests/no-game-imports.test.ts:67. [11] commit = typecheck+tests+lint - .githooks/pre-commit with `git config core.hooksPath` = .githooks, mirrored by .github/workflows/ci.yml. PARTIAL (2): [12] dependency direction - core->core|config and config->config are enforced (config-purity.test.ts:59,69) but nothing constrains src/game's own import set; [13] 'reference material never distributed' - .gitignore:8 'reference/' covers the local half only. PROSE-ONLY (23), no test, no hook, no script: videos-are-primary-reference / open-a-frame-before-grading (CLAUDE.md:10-17); Phaser 3 not v4 (CLAUDE.md:27, package.json '^3.90.0' bounds it by semver only); WebAudio-synthesized SFX only (CLAUDE.md:28 - `grep -rln AudioContext src/ tests/` returns ONLY src/game/CLAUDE.md: the subsystem does not exist yet, the rule is vacuous); Phaser scenes render-only / never own gameplay state (CLAUDE.md:34 - and UNTESTABLE by construction, since tests/no-game-imports.test.ts:67 forbids any test from importing src/game); no Math.random in core (CLAUDE.md:35, src/core/CLAUDE.md:12 - grep confirms compliance today, nothing prevents tomorrow); no Date.now in core (src/core/CLAUDE.md:13); Sim fixed-60Hz/injected mulberry32 (CLAUDE.md:34-35); don't advance stage until gate 100% green (CLAUDE.md:36); chaos-test every guard, red-first (CLAUDE.md:37); RESUME_HERE same-commit (CLAUDE.md:48 - see L-07); SESSION-LOG per-milestone (CLAUDE.md:49 - see L-08); cite symbols not line numbers (CLAUDE.md:51 - violated at docs/sessions/-SESSION-LOG.md:2591 'DuelScene.ts:691'); Number()/parseInt/Infinity banned (src/core/CLAUDE.md:19-20, which admits it: 'caught in review, not by the scanner'); every config value labeled CONTRACT/INFERRED/Spec-fixed (src/config/CLAUDE.md:7-9 - no test scans labels); config is pure data, no logic/functions/classes (src/config/CLAUDE.md:3-4 - see L-11); don't invent spec-unnamed constants (src/config/CLAUDE.md:22-23); slow-mo sets time.timeScale AND tweens.timeScale together and restores both on kill beat, shutdown and create() (src/game/CLAUDE.md:13-15 - DuelScene.ts:160-164,548-549 complies; EncounterScene.ts advances on sim.timeScale at :132 and sets NEITHER clock, ever); scenes must not accumulate HP/meters/cooldowns locally (src/game/CLAUDE.md:18-19); and all five ship-bar clauses (.claude/ship-bar.md UPFRONT / IMPROVEMENT PASS / CODE-verified-before-claiming / numbered next steps / STYLE) - .claude/settings.json's sole hook is a UserPromptSubmit that `cat`s the file into the prompt and verifies nothing. THE MECHANISM: .githooks/pre-commit contains 'Docs-only fast-path: if EVERY staged file is markdown, it can't affect build/test/lint' -> 'exit 0'. Every commit that touches only CLAUDE.md, RESUME_HERE.md, DIVERGENCES.md or -SESSION-LOG.md runs zero checks by design. The ledgers are the only artifact class in this repo with no gate at all, and they are exactly the class that rotted (L-01..L-05).
findings.rule_targeted: NONE - this row is the (c) census the brief asked for, plus the structural reason the PROSE-ONLY class rots
findings.proposed_change: Do not add prose. Add one script, scripts/ledgerLint.py, wired into the pre-commit docs-only path (so markdown commits stop being free) and into ci.yml, asserting three machine-checkable things: (1) every identifier in ALL-CAPS_SNAKE quoted in CLAUDE.md, DIVERGENCES.md or RESUME_HERE.md resolves to a declaration in src/ (this alone would have caught WEAPON_WEIGHT in L-02 and L-06, CRITICAL_MAX and critical.ts in L-01); (2) every numeric value quoted next to such an identifier matches the declaration (catches DUEL_TARGET_SECONDS {20,60} and COMBO_CHAIN_GAP_S); (3) -SESSION-LOG.md's newest date is within N commits of HEAD (catches L-08). Then mark the 23 PROSE-ONLY rules as such in place, so a reader knows which lines are load-bearing and which are aspiration.

findings.claim: src/config/CLAUDE.md's 'pure data exports - no logic, no functions' rule is violated by src/config/ogPose.ts and nothing enforces it - the config-purity gate checks imports and file extensions for config/, never its contents.
findings.evidence: src/config/CLAUDE.md:3-4: '**Purpose:** the ONLY home for gameplay values. Pure data exports - no logic, no functions, no classes, no Phaser.' src/config/ogPose.ts:210-212: `export const OG_DRESSED_SLOT_SHAPES: ReadonlyArray<readonly number[]> = OG_SLOT_SHAPES.map((shapes, slot) => TRACED[slot] ?? (OG_EQUIPMENT[slot] === undefined ? shapes : [OG_EQUIPMENT[slot].shapeId]),);` and :219-222: `export const OG_DRESSED_NODES: readonly OgPoseNode[] = OG_IDLE_NODES.map((node) => { const eq = OG_EQUIPMENT[node.slot]; return eq === undefined ? node : { ...node, rotationDeg: eq.rotationDeg, x: eq.x, y: eq.y }; });` - two arrow functions with branching, executed at module load. Enforcement: tests/config-purity.test.ts's config/ describe block contains exactly two `it`s, at :68 (imports resolve inside config/) and :72 (no unscannable payload files). Neither reads the source for logic. The numeric-literal scan that would have flagged the derivation is applied to CORE_DIR only (:52-55), never to CONFIG_DIR - by design, since config is where numbers live.
findings.rule_targeted: src/config/CLAUDE.md:3-4 - 'Pure data exports - no logic, no functions, no classes'
findings.proposed_change: The derivation is defensible (its comment at :214-218 says 'Derived, never hand-edited ... and a test pins exactly that'), so amend the rule rather than the code: 'Pure data exports. The only permitted logic is a module-scope derivation of one exported constant from another in this folder, comment-justified and pinned by a test - no imperative code, no classes, no Phaser.' Word it that way and the rule becomes checkable; leave it as-is and it is a rule the folder's own file breaks.
